newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel arrests 29 Palestinians in West Bank.
newsitem.headline: Israel arrests 29 Palestinians in West Bank.

text.p: Israeli troops arrested 29 Palestinians in the West Bank overnight in the latest sweep since last week's suicide attack, the army said on Monday.
The detentions brought to 145 the number of Arabs rounded up by the Jewish state since Wednesday's twin bombing in Jerusalem that killed 13 people.
"In the framework of activity by the army and security forces overnight 29 Palestinians were arrested on suspicion of involvement in hostile terrorist activity," an army spokesman said.
Security forces remained on high alert against more bombings, with thousands of policemen deployed at gathering places in Israeli cities.
Israel has still failed to identify the two bombers in the attack in a busy outdoor market and officials say they are not certain which group is responsible.

The Israeli government suspended peace talks with the Palestinians and sealed off the West Bank and Gaza Strip after the attack, preventing tens of thousands of Palestinians from reaching their jobs in the Jewish state.
